rows.title: Exact handle first, and a handle is only a handle
rows.defect: the handle step runs for every query, so a first name that equals someone's handle resolves silently
rows.test: @marcus resolves by handle; a bare "marcus" shared by two people asks

rows.title: Full name second
rows.defect: the full-name step is skipped, so a first-name match wins
rows.test: "sam" picks the saved Sam, not Sam K

rows.title: First name, after the handle and the nickname
rows.defect: the first-name step is skipped, so every first name is a stranger
rows.test: a unique first name goes straight to the card

rows.title: Two matches ask and stage nothing
rows.defect: an ambiguous first name takes the first match
rows.test: "Which Marcus: Marcus L or Marcus T?" with no card and no loop confirmation

rows.title: A handle look-alike is named
rows.defect: the look-alike window is zero edits, so a near handle is a stranger with no warning
rows.test: @sarah-m next to a saved @sarah_m is named, never resolved

rows.title: A name look-alike is asked about
rows.defect: names are never compared for near misses

rows.title: Saved goes straight to the card
rows.defect: only payment history counts, so every saved row with no history is sent down the new-recipient path
rows.test: a saved row with no history gets the PAY-001 card

rows.title: A stranger is asked who, and nothing is staged
rows.defect: an unknown name is staged directly with a guessed handle
rows.test: an unknown name asks for the app and handle; no card exists

rows.title: The handle is typed back exactly
rows.defect: any reply counts as the read-back
rows.test: @dana_k for @dana-k does not match; two misses stop

rows.title: The stranger's card is the full first-send card
rows.defect: a confirmed stranger is sent under the saved-recipient capability
rows.test: the loop sees PAY-002 (T5) for a confirmed stranger

rows.title: Saved only after a completed send
rows.defect: a staged handoff is saved as a completed send
rows.test: staging saves nobody; the posted debit saves with the transaction as evidence

rows.title: Or an explicit SAVE, never a mention
rows.defect: any approval counts as a confirmed save, read-back or not
rows.test: a save without the read-back is refused

rows.title: Split resolves through the same layer
rows.defect: split takes the first candidate when a name is ambiguous
rows.test: split asks the same "Which Marcus" question as pay

rows.title: Unreadable recipients are said, not guessed
rows.defect: an unreadable table is treated as an empty one
rows.test: pay and split say the recipients cannot be read

rows.title: A handle per app, and the card shows the right one
rows.defect: the card keeps the most recent row's handle whatever app the money goes by
rows.test: with no app named, the card shows the handle on the app the money goes by

rows.title: Follow-up replies never reach the model
rows.defect: follow-up replies are not routed, so they go to the model and are lost
rows.test: a handle, YES, SAVE and "marcus t" go to the asking flow with zero model calls
